The '''Tiaran'grast Sling Course''' was one of the newest and most challenging [[Sling racing|sling race]] courses on [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]]. Located only 40 kilometers south of the [[Drev'starn|capital]]. It drew immense crowds on race days, as well as planet's elite during raucous parties and expensive private receptions. 

It was one of the few to feature artificially placed obstacles such as stone pillars, energy fields and repulsor mines. The track was known for vicious cross-currents in the "South Swing." Amateur sling racers were not allowed on the course because it was so challenging.
